findings.reason: The v05 header set and transition remain unchanged. Validation explicitly excludes attempts, active_attempt_id and ledger_sha256 from fixed-header equality, but checks original accepted prefix and current ledger checksum.

Each immutable operation/grant head is reconstructed from its own counted prefix with active_attempt_id=None. All original50 rows and fixed headers remain exact; earlier count44 and other old heads therefore do not change. The fresh operation records the newly released50-row head, which equals its later reconstructed50-row prefix.

The exact selected attempt remains UNKNOWN and counted. Bare active=None without the new receipt leaves it in pending and fails task_scope_active_or_unknown. The appended wrapper adds only selected ID after full exact receipt/proposal/predecessor verification.

Both new tasks and sources must be absent from the captured before state. Live/before-begin checks reread current exact source bytes. Historical round validation preserves immutable receipts without requiring deliberately revised raw source to equal its earlier value.

limits: No runtime execution performed by author.
The isolated linked control uses explicit doubles for old historical admission and validates the actual new predicates and pending/ack accounting.
No archived controller, Root, Work or model permission is restored.
Final current profile admission and explicit future owner decision remain separate independent requirements.
